title: spec+docs(object-extension `fieldPatches`): the documented example patches option `tech`, which `crm_account.industry` does not store, so a copy is refused at `os validate`
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Filing gate: ② a should-fix of the contract review on PR #28795 (record 6563471541), carried there only for the skill, because the spec and docs copies are outside that card's file surface (#28730). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade or lane: triage sets them.
Reader: the spec lane (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) and the docs owner (`content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "fieldPatches tech" in:body → only #28655 (a different rule: a field both replaced in `fields` and patched); "fieldPatches example" → none.
reach: every AI or human author who copies the documented `fieldPatches` example.

## Measured on `main` (`0aaad18fc0`)

- The reference field `crm_account.industry` (`examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts`) is an inline `Field.select` with stored values `technology` (default), `finance`, `healthcare`, `retail`, `other`. Its label for `technology` is already "Technology".
- The example patches `options: { tech: { label: 'Technology' } }` in four places:
  - `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L4838 (`.describe()` prose)
  - `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L4882 (TSDoc example)
  - `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L4966 (`.describe()` example)
  - `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` L113
- `tech` names no stored option, so a copy is refused at `os validate` and at install with reason `option` (`fieldPatchTargetMisses`). The error is loud, but the docs teach a broken example.
- The skill copy is fixed on PR #28795 as `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }`.

## Wanted

- The four copies key the option by a real stored value (for example `technology: { label: 'Tech' }`), matching PR #28795.
- The `.describe()` change re-records whatever the spec's generated outputs need, in the same PR.
- `.changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md` L20 carries the same example. Change it only if it is still unreleased when this card is worked.

Links back: #28565, PR #28728, #28730, PR #28795.
